<thought>Based on the spectrum, the dominant isotopic pattern is a pair of peaks separated by ~2 Da with nearly equal intensities (100 and ~98). This is the characteristic signature of bromine (79Br/81Br ≈ 1:1). No other element shows a definitive isotopic pattern (e.g., chlorine would give a ~1:3 M+2 ratio, sulfur a much smaller M+2). Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is bromine.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
